taskVersion.name: ves-real-item

parts.text:
Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station Bori-police-station, Bori Metropolis. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 150 | 1.23 | 1.23
2 | 97.1 | 6.21 | 7.44
3 | 284 | 37.5 | 45
4 | 700 | - | -

What is the curve type of this station? Give a short answer, then end with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type": "<letters>"}

To determine the curve-type notation, we examine the resistivities of the layers in order:
1. $r_1 = 150$ $\Omega\text{m}$
2. $r_2 = 97.1$ $\Omega\text{m}$
3. $r_3 = 284$ $\Omega\text{m}$
4. $r_4 = 700$ $\Omega\text{m}$

Next, we evaluate groups of three consecutive layers:
- **Group 1 (Layers 1-2-3):** $r_1 = 150, r_2 = 97.1, r_3 = 284$.
  Since $150 > 97.1$ and $97.1 < 284$ ($r_1 > r_2 < r_3$), this corresponds to the letter **H**.
- **Group 2 (Layers 2-3-4):** $r_2 = 97.1, r_3 = 284, r_4 = 700$.
  Since $97.1 < 284$ and $284 < 700$ ($r_2 < r_3 < r_4$), this corresponds to the letter **A**.

Combining these in depth order, we get the curve type **HA**.

{"curve_type": "HA"}
